features.name: supplied_log_length
features.definition: What is the supplied log-transformed length value for the discussion?
features.spec: df['supplied_log_length'] = pd.to_numeric(df['log_length'], errors='coerce'). Use the supplied value as-is (no recomputation, no log-base assumption); missing or non-numeric gives null.

h0: supplied_log_length has no association with the likelihood that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Higher supplied_log_length is associated with a higher likelihood that the OP changed their view (delta).
note: Uses the supplied log_length column as given; its construction, source text, log base and timing relative to the outcome are undocumented, and it is not equated with argument word count. It may include post-outcome text. OLS on binary delta is a linear probability model; the result is an association, not a causal effect.
